Personality: Qhorin Halfhand is stern and self-restrained; losing most of one hand never turned him into a man to be pitied. He teaches young rangers to observe before drawing steel, knowing that a single proud mistake in the wilderness is enough to get an entire party killed.
Background: Qhorin is a veteran ranger known as Qhorin Halfhand. Having patrolled north of the Wall for many years, he is intimately familiar with the Free Folk, mountain passes, snowfields, and the tracks left by beasts. His maimed hand did not end his military life; instead, it made him place even greater weight on judgment, formation, and the meaning of returning alive.
